title: K-Iced Single Serve Coffee Maker - Grey

reviews.title: So nice we bought 2 - 1 for us and 1 for our daughters dorm room
reviews.body: Personally - As a busy parent, having a quick and convenient way to start the day is essential. The Keurig K-Iced Single Serve Coffee Maker has been a game-changer for our household.Design and Build Quality:The sleek gray design fits perfectly on our kitchen counter, adding a modern touch to our space. The build quality is excellent, and the machine feels sturdy and reliable.Functionality:The ability to brew both hot and cold beverages is a fantastic feature. I enjoy a hot cup of coffee in the morning, while my spouse prefers iced coffee. This Keurig caters to both our preferences effortlessly.Ease of Use:Using the K-Iced Coffee Maker is incredibly simple. The straightforward controls and quick brewing time make it perfect for our hectic mornings. We can each have our preferred coffee ready in minutes without any fuss.Performance:The coffee maker consistently delivers delicious coffee, whether hot or cold. The iced coffee feature brews directly over ice, ensuring a perfectly chilled drink without diluting the flavor.Convenience:Cleaning and maintaining the machine is hassle-free. The removable drip tray and water reservoir make it easy to keep everything clean and ready for use.Pros:Sleek and modern designBrews both hot and cold beveragesEasy to use with quick brewing timeConsistently great taste for both hot and iced coffeeEasy to clean and maintainCons:The water reservoir could be a bit larger for fewer refillsIt tends to drip after removing cleaning it and removing the K-cup (this is annoying - Thus the 4 stars for cleaning)For My Daughter starting college was a big transition, and having the convenience of a morning cup of coffee was a must (probably good for those in class with her as well)Pros:Design: The compact size fits perfectly in my dorm room, and the gray color looks sleek and stylish. It doesn’t take up much space, which is a big plus in a small room.Ease of Use:The coffee maker is super easy to use. The controls are intuitive, and it brews quickly, which is great when I’m rushing to class. It’s also easy to set up and requires minimal effort to get my coffee ready.Cons: Same as aboveThe Keurig K-Iced Single Serve Coffee Maker has been a fantastic addition both at home and in my daughter's dorm room. It offers the convenience of brewing both hot and cold beverages quickly and easily, with consistently great taste. Whether you’re a busy parent or a college student, this coffee maker is a reliable and stylish choice to start your day right.

reviews.author: Bryan L.

reviews.title: Perfect for hot and iced coffee lovers alike!
reviews.body: This coffee maker is a game-changer for coffee enthusiasts who enjoy both hot and iced beverages. The Keurig K-Iced Single Serve Coffee Maker not only brews piping hot coffee but also makes smooth and flavorful iced coffee at the touch of a button. I was particularly impressed with how easy it is to switch between the two modes, ensuring I get the perfect cup every time.The sleek gray design fits beautifully into my kitchen, and its compact size doesn’t take up much counter space. The machine is also very intuitive to use, with a straightforward control panel and quick brewing time. The iced coffee setting is a standout feature—it cools the coffee perfectly without watering it down.Diving into my experience, I’ve been using this coffee maker every morning for hot brews and every afternoon for iced drinks. It’s been a joy to experiment with different flavors and strengths, thanks to the adjustable settings. Cleanup is a breeze as well, with removable parts that are easy to rinse or wash.The delivery was prompt, arriving in perfect condition, and setup took less than 10 minutes. Overall, I wholeheartedly recommend this machine to anyone looking for a versatile and stylish coffee maker.

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.body: This Keurig iced coffee maker has been really convenient for quick homemade iced coffee. I like that it’s simple to use and doesn’t take up too much counter space. The brew setting for iced coffee actually works well — the coffee comes out strong enough that it doesn’t taste watered down once poured over ice.It heats up fast, brews quickly, and works with regular K-Cups, which is nice since there are plenty of flavor options. I’ve used it for both hot and iced drinks, and it handles both well.

reviews.title: Forget it!!!
reviews.body: Love the coffee (hot and iced) that this compact coffee maker provides.Only problem was it stopped working less than a month after I received it.  Keurig diagnosed as "defective". Amazon no stock to replace it (offered a refund), but Keurig offered a free replacement after sending the the documentation and photos.  Takes about a week to replace through manufacturer.  Can't wait to use it again!Now -- fed up!!  Keurig replaced my first defective K-Ice.  I received it on the 13th, and it stopped working on the 18th!!!  Again, Keurig decided it was defective, and will replace it AGAIN after I send them all the photos of machine and serial number sticker, then I need to return it to them to get another free replacement.  I will also need to ship this one back to them.  I asked if the model was defective, and if this would just happen again -- they said that if the next one is also defective they will talk about possible other options.  VERY FRUSTRATING!!  Don't bother with this one unless you want to replace it over and over!

reviews.title: Worst Keurig I've Ever Owned
reviews.body: I've had Keurig coffee makers since they first came out. Some have lasted years, others not so much-- as the years pass, the newer models don't last as long (one quit after only two weeks). The convenience is good, but I also like to use my own coffee, so I bought a pair of official Keurig K-Cup reusable filters.I will say that this is the worst Keurig coffee maker I've ever owned. I meant to send the thing back, but ended up traveling and returning home one day after the return period had expired. This Keurig drips, dribbles, leaks, and generally makes a huge mess. If you don't make sure that your cup is pushed all the way to the back and against the coffee maker, get ready to clean up. A half inch of space will get you photographs 1 and 2. Coffee will splatter onto the coffee maker and down the side of your cup, filling the catch basin below it. In photograph 2 you can see how the leaked coffee spreads all the way around to the side of the coffee maker. Your cup is sitting in it, so you have to put the cup on a paper towel or get coffee all over your counter or table. To make a bad situation worse, the thing is almost impossible to clean-- you can't get your fingers in there adequately. Even the reusuable filters end up a mess-- grounds everywhere as if the coffee maker full force blows hot water into it. After the coffee is finished, the coffee maker will still drip and dribble for some time. You can't turn the coffee maker off, so there are bright white-- and really irritating-- flashing lights (you can see them in photograph 2) for five minutes. If you want to stop them, your only option is to unplug the coffee maker. This Keurig coffee maker is so aggravating and messy, it makes me want to never buy a Keurig again.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 23, 2025
reviews.author: Yvonne Navarro

reviews.title: Happy for the upgrade!
reviews.body: So I needed to replace my old 2.0 Keurig that I bought years ago. It was starting to be unreliable, and also not being able to brew anything without the QR code on top was becoming a problem. After a lot of research and online comparisons I stumbled across this brand new model that seemed to have everything I was looking for!Features I needed - strong brew, reservoir (hate filling each time), and tall enough to fit my 16oz tumbler without removing the tray.Nice to have features - under $100, smaller footprint, iced coffeeJust a quick aside to address another comment or two that complained about a plastic smell - I rinsed the reservoir and ran about four cups of water through before I brewed my first actual k cup and I didn’t notice any different than usual taste.The brew seems to be just as fast as the 2.0, not sure about the strong brew yet, will test more tomorrow - after three cups of coffee today I decided I’d better stop before I had too much caffeine!I did try out the iced feature though, and it was perfect. Very excited to have this option for summer!For anyone confused - iced is not the same as cold brew. The coffee brewed will still come out of the machine hot, you will need ice. The machine just brews a stronger liquid in a smaller amount so that when the ice melts, it doesn’t taste watered down. I filled a Pyrex  measuring cup to 1 cup of nugget ice and then brewed at the 8oz iced setting, it ended up being 8oz total including the ice and the coffee together. I added my regular creamer (natural bliss vanilla) and it tasted great!The counter space being taken up seems to be cut in half, which I am super excited for. I will miss the LED screen I think, but since it didn’t always work right, I’m probably safer with the buttons!So to sum up, if you’re looking for a machine with the qualities I wanted, the K Ice seems like it will do a good job. (If anything changes, I promise to update my review!)

features: BREW OVER ICE - Automatically adjusts brewing temperature, starting warmer to help extract full flavor, then cooling for less melted ice.
STRONG BREWING - Brews stronger and more intense hot coffee.
3 cup sizes - 8oz, 10oz, and 12oz (for iced coffee, including ice)
Removable 40 oz reservoir - allows you to brew up to 4 cups between refills.
FAST AND FRESH - Delicious iced coffee and hot coffee made in minutes.
ICE CONTAINER FRIENDLY - Removable drip tray accommodates glasses and travel cups up to 7" tall and holds a full accidental brew for easy cleanup.
ENERGY EFFICIENT - The automatic shut-off feature shuts off the coffee maker 5 minutes after the last brew, helping to save energy.
COMPATIBLE WITH THE MY K-CUP UNIVERSAL COFFEE FILTER - Brew with your own ground coffee (sold separately).
